item.title: iPhone 18 Pro 系列首批多平台售罄，部分型号发货延至 10 月
item.guid: iPhone-18-Pro-系列首批多平台售罄，部分型号发货延至-10-月
item.description:
Apple iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-orders began at 8 PM on September 12th. The two models start at 9999 yuan and 10999 yuan respectively, both with 256GB storage, and are available in black, silver, glacier blue, and burgundy red. They will officially go on sale on the 18th of this month. 苹果 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 已于 9 月 12 日晚 8 点开启预购，两款机型起售价分别为 9999 元和 10999 元，均从 256GB 存储起步，提供黑色、银色、冰川蓝色和勃艮第酒红色。本月 18 日正式发售。

When pre-orders began, Apple's official website and the Apple Store App were temporarily inaccessible due to high traffic, gradually recovering after about 6 minutes. The first day's release batch quickly sold out on multiple platforms, and the shipping time for some popular models on Apple's official website has been extended to late September or October; glacier blue and burgundy red were the first to run out of initial stock. 预购开始时，苹果官网和 Apple Store App 一度因访问量较大无法进入，约 6 分钟后才陆续恢复。首日发售批次在多个平台快速售罄，苹果官网部分热门型号的发货时间已顺延到 9 月底或 10 月；其中冰川蓝和勃艮第酒红色首批库存最先耗尽。

item.title: Gurman：iPhone Duo 有望成为苹果历史级产品
item.guid: Gurman：iPhone-Duo-有望成为苹果历史级产品
item.description:
Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman reviewed the newly released foldable phone iPhone Duo in his "Power On" newsletter, and disclosed information about Apple's retail store renovation plans and the brand attribution of new game controllers. 彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 在其「Power On」通讯中评价了新发布的折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo，并披露了苹果零售门店改造计划及新款游戏手柄的品牌归属信息。

Gurman believes that the iPhone Duo is significant enough to secure a place in Apple's historical product lineup, second only to the 1998 iMac, 2001 iPod, 2010 iPad, and 2015 Apple Watch. Gurman 认为，iPhone Duo 足以在苹果历史级产品序列中占据一席之地，仅次于 1998 年的 iMac、2001 年的 iPod、2010 年的 iPad 和 2015 年的 Apple Watch。

He predicts that foldable phones will account for the majority of new phone sales within the next decade, but due to their higher price, the adoption rate will be slower than when smartphones replaced feature phones. He also mentioned that Face ID and telephoto lenses are expected to be realized in the third-generation iPhone Duo through hardware miniaturization and improved AI computing capabilities. 他预计，未来十年内折叠屏手机将占据新机销量的多数，但由于售价较高，普及速度将慢于当年智能手机对功能机的替代过程。他还提到，Face ID 与长焦镜头预计要到第三代 iPhone Duo 才能通过硬件小型化与 AI 计算能力的提升实现。

The report also mentioned that Apple is preparing for a major store overhaul, including restoring independent Genius Bars, removing large video walls, and adding dedicated areas for online pickup and "Today at Apple." These plans will be gradually rolled out to stores worldwide over the next few years. 报道同时提到，苹果正在筹备门店大改造，包括恢复独立 Genius Bar、拆除大型视频墙，并新增线上取货与「Today at Apple」专属区域，相关计划将在未来数年内逐步向全球门店推广。

Additionally, according to leaks, two iPhone game controllers currently under development by Apple are expected to be released under the Beats brand, rather than the Apple brand, to align with third-party accessory market pricing. This claim has not yet been officially confirmed. Gurman also mentioned that a new Apple TV set-top box is expected to be launched this autumn along with a new version of Siri AI. 此外，据爆料，苹果开发中的两款 iPhone 游戏手柄预计将以 Beats 品牌发布，而非 Apple 品牌，以便贴近第三方配件市场定价，该说法尚未获得官方确认。Gurman 还提到，新款 Apple TV 机顶盒预计将于今年秋季随新版 Siri AI 一同推出。

item.title: 智谱完成约 50 亿美元融资，主要用于下一代模型研发
item.guid: 智谱完成约-50-亿美元融资，主要用于下一代模型研发
item.description:
According to a Reuters report on September 13, Zhipu disclosed in a Hong Kong Stock Exchange filing that it has raised approximately US$5 billion in total through a US$2 billion Hong Kong share placement and a US$3 billion convertible bond issuance. Both transactions were initiated on September 11, and documents disclosed on Sunday confirmed the fundraising results. 据路透社 9 月 13 日报道，智谱在港交所文件中披露，已通过约 20 亿美元港股配售和约 30 亿美元可转债发行，合计募集约 50 亿美元。两项交易于 9 月 11 日启动，周日披露的文件确认了募资结果。

The share placement price is HK$714 per share, a discount of approximately 10% from last Friday's closing price. The convertible bonds are zero-coupon bonds, maturing in September 2027, denominated in RMB and settled in USD, with an issue price of 100.5% of face value; the initial conversion price is HK$892.50 per share, a 25% premium over the placement price. 股份配售价为每股 714 港元，较上周五收盘价折让约 10%。可转债为零息债券，2027 年 9 月到期，以人民币计价、美元结算，发行价为面值的 100.5%；初始转股价为每股 892.50 港元，较配售价溢价 25%。

Zhipu stated that approximately 60% of the net proceeds will be used for the research and development of next-generation models and a fully self-training system, another 15% for business expansion, and the remainder for optimizing capital structure, supplementing daily working capital, and other general corporate purposes. 智谱表示，约 60% 的净募集资金将用于下一代模型和完全自训练体系研发，另有约 15% 用于业务扩张，其余用于优化资本结构、补充日常营运资金及其他一般公司用途。

item.title: 荣耀回应「魔法画报耽误拨打 120」争议：发帖与事实不符，不予追究
item.guid: 荣耀回应「魔法画报耽误拨打-120」争议：发帖与事实不符，不予追究
item.description:
According to Southern Metropolis Daily, on the evening of September 10, a netizen posted that after his mother suffered a sudden heart attack, his father was unable to unlock his Honor phone to call for help due to the "Magic Magazine" feature, missing the best rescue time, which attracted widespread attention from netizens. The netizen stated that his mother had a sudden heart attack and collapsed in the bathroom at 4 AM. When his father tried to call for help, he accidentally touched the Magic Magazine, and because he couldn't find the exit button, he had to run out and knock on doors to find someone. 据南方都市报报道，9月10日晚，有网友发文称，母亲突发心梗后，因荣耀手机「魔法画报」导致父亲无法解锁手机拨打抢救电话，错过最佳抢救时间，引发大量网友关注。该网友表示，母亲凌晨四点突发心梗倒在厕所，父亲欲拨打求救电话时误触了魔法画报，因找不到退出按钮，只好跑出去一家家敲门找人。

According to reports, on the afternoon of September 11, with the witness of third-party personnel, Mr. Zhang, the party involved, had a face-to-face communication with Honor, and the usage scenario at the time was recreated on site. Mr. Zhang stated that in the early morning of the incident, his elderly father, who suffers from cerebral infarction, successfully made an emergency call using an Honor X70. Due to emotional distress from the sudden family change, he misunderstood that the phone had failed to make the call. 据报道，9月11日下午，在第三方人员的见证下，当事人张先生与荣耀方进行了面对面沟通，现场还原了当时使用场景。张先生表示，事发凌晨，其身患脑梗的年迈父亲使用荣耀 X70 正常对外拨打了求救电话，其因家庭突发变故情绪激动，误解是手机问题导致没有拨通电话。

He stated that the original intention of his post was to hope that phone companies would pay attention to this issue to prevent tragedies. After communication, he realized that it was unrelated to the Honor phone, and some content in his online post did not match the actual situation, for which he apologized for the impact caused to the Honor brand. 他表示，发帖本意是希望手机公司能够重视这个问题，避免发生悲剧，经过沟通才发现与荣耀手机无关，网上所发帖子中有部分内容与实情不符，并为给荣耀品牌造成的影响致歉。

In response, Honor stated that it expressed condolences for the passing of Mr. Zhang's mother, and also said that the "post inconsistent with facts" incident caused brand damage to Honor, but out of humanitarian concern, Honor would not pursue the matter. 对此，荣耀方面回应称，对张先生母亲的去世表示哀悼，同时表示「发帖与事实不符」这件事对荣耀造成了品牌伤害，但出于人道主义关怀，荣耀将不予追究。

item.title: 黄仁勋重申：2030 年全球 AI 基础设施年支出将达 3 万亿至 4 万亿美元
item.guid: 黄仁勋重申：2030-年全球-AI-基础设施年支出将达-3-万亿至-4-万亿美元
item.description:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reiterated his prediction at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 10 that global annual spending on AI infrastructure will reach US$3 trillion to US$4 trillion by 2030. He believes that computing is shifting from retrieving existing information to generating real-time answers, and with the slowdown of Moore's Law, chips, complete machines, and data centers need integrated collaborative design. 英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在 9 月 10 日举行的高盛 Communacopia + Technology Conference 上，重申全球 AI 基础设施年支出到 2030 年将达到 3 万亿至 4 万亿美元的预测。他认为，计算正在从检索已有信息转向实时生成答案，叠加摩尔定律放缓，芯片、整机与数据中心需要一体化协同设计。

Jensen Huang stated that supply constraints for AI infrastructure exist simultaneously upstream and downstream: advanced packaging, DRAM, LPDDR memory, connectors, voltage regulators, and wafers are all under pressure, and there are also shortages in land, power, and factory buildings required for data centers. Nvidia is expanding its delivery channels through cloud service providers, OEMs, sovereign AI projects, and new cloud vendors, and is tracking the construction progress of data center projects in various regions. 黄仁勋表示，AI 基础设施的供给约束同时存在于上下游：先进封装、DRAM、LPDDR 内存、连接器、电压调节器和晶圆都面临压力，数据中心所需的土地、电力与厂房也存在缺口。英伟达正通过云服务商、OEM、主权 AI 项目和新型云厂商扩大交付渠道，并跟踪各地数据中心项目的建设进度。

Regarding market doubts that Nvidia's investment in customers might form "circular financing," Jensen Huang stated that the company's invested capital accounts for only a small portion of the projects, and decision-making is based on factors including customers' signed computing power orders and actual demand. He also predicted that physical AI applications such as autonomous driving would make significant progress in the next two to three years. 对于市场质疑英伟达投资客户可能形成「循环融资」，黄仁勋称，公司投入的资金只占项目的一小部分，决策依据包括客户已经签订的算力订单与实际需求。他还预计，自动驾驶等物理 AI 应用会在未来两到三年取得明显进展。

item.title: 英伟达洽谈成为 Anthropic IPO 基石投资者
item.guid: 英伟达洽谈成为-Anthropic-IPO-基石投资者
item.description:
According to Reuters, Anthropic is in talks with Nvidia for the latter to act as a cornerstone investor in its IPO. Two informed sources said that Anthropic hopes to raise up to US$100 billion through the listing, with a corresponding valuation possibly reaching approximately US$2 trillion; one of them stated that Nvidia is considering investing up to US$10 billion. 据路透社报道，Anthropic 正与英伟达商谈由后者担任 IPO 基石投资者。两名知情人士称，Anthropic 希望通过上市筹集最多 1000 亿美元，对应估值可能达到约 2 万亿美元；其中一人称，英伟达考虑投资最多 100 亿美元。

The relevant negotiations may still be adjusted, and the financing scale, valuation, and Nvidia's final subscription amount have not been determined. If completed at the current upper limit, this transaction could become the largest IPO in history and would further deepen the capital ties between model companies, chip suppliers, and computing power purchasers. 相关谈判仍可能调整，融资规模、估值和英伟达的最终认购额都没有确定。若按当前上限完成，这笔交易可能成为有史以来规模最大的 IPO，也会进一步加深模型公司、芯片供应商与算力采购之间的资本联系。

item.title: 奥特曼确认 OpenAI 今年不会上市，将先完成 AI 安全工作
item.guid: 奥特曼确认-OpenAI-今年不会上市，将先完成-AI-安全工作
item.description:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman confirmed in an interview published by Fortune on September 12 that the company will not go public in 2026. He stated that considering the current AI safety issues, now is not the right time for an IPO, and OpenAI is not under pressure to go public. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在《财富》 9 月 12 日发布的专访中确认，公司不会在 2026 年上市。他表示，考虑到目前的 AI 安全问题，现在并非合适的上市时机，OpenAI 也没有急于 IPO 的压力。

Altman said that the IPO would have to wait until the business, the company itself, and society's readiness for the technology are all prepared. When asked by reporters about this year's IPO plans, he explicitly replied, "Not in 2026," adding that the company still has a lot of work to do. Altman 说，上市要等到业务、公司自身，以及社会面对这项技术的状态都准备好。当记者追问今年的上市安排时，他明确回答「不是 2026 年」，并称公司还有大量工作要做。

During the interview, he also stated that the most advanced, unreleased models are already very powerful; before further enhancing their capabilities, it is necessary to first improve the ability to monitor model behavior, align them, and ensure they adhere to human values and user intentions. If safety requires pausing or even stopping AI development, he is willing to explain it to investors. 采访中，他还表示，最先进、尚未发布的模型能力已经很强；在进一步提升能力之前，需要先改善监控模型行为、对齐，以及确保模型遵循人类价值与用户意图的能力。如果安全需要暂停甚至停止 AI 开发，他愿意向投资者说明。

Regarding suggestions for jointly developing safety plans with peers like Anthropic and Google DeepMind, Altman expressed an expectation of cooperation but did not disclose private discussions in advance. He emphasized that the industry cannot allow personal animosity or profit incentives to impede safety responsibilities. 对于与 Anthropic、Google DeepMind 等同行共同制定安全方案的建议，Altman 表示预期会有合作，但没有提前公布私下讨论。他强调，行业不能让个人意气或利润激励妨碍安全责任。

item.title: 美国律师因 ChatGPT 编造刑事案件证词被罚 5000 美元
item.guid: 美国律师因-ChatGPT-编造刑事案件证词被罚-5000-美元
item.description:
The New Mexico Supreme Court ruled that attorney Stephen Aarons submitted police testimony fabricated by ChatGPT and fictitious witness statements in a murder appeal. The court found him in contempt for failing to verify the accuracy of the documents, fined him $5,000, and referred the case to the attorney disciplinary board. 美国新墨西哥州最高法院认定，律师 Stephen Aarons 在一宗谋杀案上诉材料中提交了由 ChatGPT 编造的警察证词和虚构证人陈述。法院以未核实文件准确性为由判其藐视法庭，并处以 5000 美元罚款，同时把案件转交律师纪律机构处理。

Aarons told Reuters that when he took over the appeal last year, he used ChatGPT to summarize trial records and was unaware that the system would fabricate facts out of thin air. The court found that he still lacked remorse after the problem was exposed and did not adequately consider the client's interests; the appeal of the original criminal case is still ongoing. Aarons 对路透社表示，他在去年接手上诉时用 ChatGPT 总结庭审记录，没有意识到系统会凭空编造事实。法院认为，他在问题暴露后仍缺乏悔意，也没有充分顾及客户利益；原刑事案件的上诉仍在审理中。

item.title: 集邦咨询预计 iPhone Duo 今年出货 500 万台，占折叠屏市场近四分之一
item.guid: 集邦咨询预计-iPhone-Duo-今年出货-500-万台，占折叠屏市场近四分之一
item.description:
TrendForce's report, published on September 10, estimates that Apple's first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, will ship approximately 5 million units this year, accounting for about 24.8% of the global foldable phone market. In the same forecast, Samsung is expected to ship about 7.1 million units, accounting for 35.1%; Huawei about 5 million units, accounting for 24.8%. 集邦咨询在 9 月 10 日发布的报告中预计，苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 今年出货约 500 万台，在全球折叠屏手机市场的份额约为 24.8%。同一份预测中，三星约为 710 万台、占 35.1%；华为约为 500 万台、占 24.8%。

The report estimates that global foldable phone shipments will be approximately 20.2 million units in 2026, a year-on-year increase of 0.5%. After excluding the increase brought by Apple, Android brands combined will account for approximately 15.2 million units, a year-on-year decrease of over 20%. TrendForce attributes the pressure on Android shipments mainly to rising component costs, with most brands seeing flat or declining shipments. 报告预计，2026 年全球折叠屏手机出货量约为 2020 万台，同比增长 0.5%。剔除苹果带来的增量后，安卓品牌合计约为 1520 万台，同比下降逾 20%。集邦咨询将安卓阵营出货承压主要归因于零部件成本上涨，多数品牌的出货量持平或下降。

The report also analyzed the screen structure of the iPhone Duo: the inner screen uses an OLED stack composed of ten layers of ultra-thin materials, combined with Nano-texture surface treatment to reduce glare and the visual visibility of creases. TrendForce believes that crease improvement requires the joint design of glass, adhesive layers, display modules, and support structures. 报告还分析了 iPhone Duo 的屏幕结构：内屏采用十层超薄材料组成的 OLED 堆叠，并配合 Nano-texture 表面处理，降低反光和折痕的视觉可见度。集邦咨询认为，折痕改善需要玻璃、胶层、显示模组与支撑结构共同设计。

item.title: 从 Demo 到规模化复制，蚂蚁灵波外滩大会三问具身智能
item.guid: 从-Demo-到规模化复制，蚂蚁灵波外滩大会三问具身智能
item.description:
On September 11, Ant Lingbo hosted an Embodied AI Forum at the 2026 Inclusion·Bund Conference. Participating researchers and enterprise leaders discussed general intelligence, training data, and scenario replication in their public speeches, including the capabilities model architectures should possess, data filtering methods, and commercialization standards. 9 月 11 日，蚂蚁灵波在 2026 Inclusion·外滩大会举办具身智能论坛。与会研究者和企业负责人在公开发言中讨论了通用大脑、训练数据和场景复制，包括模型架构应具备的能力、数据筛选方法和商业化标准。

Shen Yujun, Chief Scientist of Ant Lingbo, believes that embodied models need to extract effective representations from continuous sensor signals, integrate modalities such as vision and touch, and generate executable actions. Measuring model progress should not only look at single demos but also consider whether partners' scenario deployment costs have decreased, and whether robots are safe and stable when operating for extended periods in open environments. 蚂蚁灵波首席科学家沈宇军认为，具身模型需要从连续传感器信号中提取有效表征、融合视觉与触觉等模态，并生成可执行动作。衡量模型进步不能只看单次 Demo，还应看合作伙伴的场景部署成本是否下降，以及机器人在开放环境中长时间运行时是否安全、稳定。

Regarding data, Huang Yongtao, Chief Data Scientist of Ant Lingbo, stated that the number of robots in real production and service scenarios is still small, and failures and feedback have not fully flowed back. After data quality surpasses engineering baselines like frame drops and clock desynchronization, it should be determined by the training objective and repeatedly verified through targeted datasets and training results. 数据方面，蚂蚁灵波首席数据科学家黄用韬称，真实生产与服务场景中的机器人数量仍少，失败和反馈没有充分回流；数据质量越过掉帧、时钟不同步等工程底线后，应由训练目标决定，并通过定向数据集与训练结果反复验证。

Several enterprise leaders advocated for robots to enter real-world scenarios as early as possible but also pointed out that current generalization capabilities are mainly limited to single scenarios and single tasks. Wang Xiaogang, Chairman of Daxiao Robotics, proposed that a business model is only sustainable if thousands of robots appear in a single scenario and purchasers can achieve break-even. Ant Lingbo also announced the launch of an embodied large model challenge based on LingBot-VLA 2.0. 多位企业负责人主张让机器人尽早进入真实场景，但也指出目前的泛化能力主要停留在单场景、单任务。大晓机器人董事长王晓刚提出，只有单一场景出现数千台机器人、购买方能够实现盈亏平衡，商业模式才算具备持续性。蚂蚁灵波还宣布启动基于 LingBot-VLA 2.0 的具身大模型挑战赛。

item.title: 💡 Dario Amodei：AI 模型能力提升速度应主动放慢
item.guid: 💡-Dario-Amodei：AI-模型能力提升速度应主动放慢
item.description:
Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, published a lengthy article on September 12, advocating that frontier AI companies proactively slow down the pace of model capability improvement. He emphasized that "slowing down" does not mean stopping training or technological progress, but rather allocating time for alignment, safety protection, and third-party evaluations. Anthropic CEO 达里奥·阿莫迪 9 月 12 日发表长文，主张前沿 AI 公司主动放慢模型能力的提升速度。他强调，「放慢」并非停止训练或技术进步，而是留出时间做对齐、安全防护和第三方评测。

Amodei summarized his concerns into two points. First, AI is increasingly involved in the development of the next generation of AI, and recursive self-improvement could cause capability growth to outpace human understanding and control. Second, the collective action and aggressive behavior demonstrated by OpenAI models in the Hugging Face incident could cause greater harm with stronger capabilities. 阿莫迪把担忧归结为两点。其一，AI 正在更多参与下一代 AI 的研发，递归式自我改进可能让能力增长速度超过人类理解和控制的速度；其二，OpenAI 模型在 Hugging Face 事件中展示出的集群行动和攻击行为，在更强能力下可能造成更大损害。

He proposed a three-step framework: first, allow independent evaluation organizations to gain continuous access similar to employees, to inspect training processes, safety measures, and incidents; then, have frontier AI companies within democratic nations coordinate safety standards and progress; finally, attempt to establish a verifiable global coordination mechanism. Anthropic announced it would be the first to implement the first step, allowing external evaluation teams to understand safety processes and independently publish key conclusions. 他提出三步框架：先让独立评估机构获得类似员工的持续访问权限，检查训练流程、安全措施和事故；再由民主国家内的前沿 AI 公司协调安全标准和进度；最后尝试建立可验证的全球协调机制。Anthropic 宣布将率先落地第一步，允许外部评估团队了解安全流程并独立发布关键结论。

🔗 Related reading: Breaking! A-company founder calls for AI industry to hit the brakes, Altman and Musk rarely show strong support 🔗 相关阅读： 突发！A 社创始人呼吁 AI 圈踩刹车，奥特曼马斯克罕见力挺

item.title: Kimi K2.8 Preview 全量上线，所有会员开放 100 万上下文
item.guid: Kimi-K2.8-Preview-全量上线，所有会员开放-100-万上下文
item.description:
Moonshot AI launched Kimi K2.8 Preview in full on Kimi Code on September 11. The model ID continues to be `kimi-for-coding`, and existing clients and third-party tools can switch to the new version without modifying configurations. 月之暗面 9 月 11 日将 Kimi K2.8 Preview 全量上线 Kimi Code。模型 ID 继续使用 `kimi-for-coding`，现有客户端和第三方工具无需修改配置即可切换到新版本。

The official statement claims that K2.8 Preview's overall performance is close to K3, with improved coding and agent capabilities compared to its predecessor, and higher thinking efficiency than K2.7 Code. The new model supports `low`, `high`, and `max` three levels of reasoning effort, with `max` being the default; all membership tiers can use a context window of up to 1 million tokens. 官方称，K2.8 Preview 的综合性能接近 K3，编码与智能体能力较前代提升，思考效率也高于 K2.7 Code。新模型支持 `low`、`high`、`max` 三档 reasoning effort，默认使用 `max`；全部会员档位均可使用最高 100 万 token 的上下文窗口。

For request routing, after the K3 series disables thinking, requests will also be routed to the K2.8 Preview's non-thinking version. Kimi Work also simultaneously launched K2.8 Preview. 在请求路由上，K3 系列关闭 thinking 后，请求也会转到 K2.8 Preview 的无思考版本。Kimi Work 同步上线了 K2.8 Preview。

item.title: Amp 推出免费 Hobby 档，自带电脑和模型订阅即可运行 Agent
item.guid: Amp-推出免费-Hobby-档，自带电脑和模型订阅即可运行-Agent
item.description:
Amp announced a change in its charging method on September 13: users can use its programming Agent for free by bringing their own computing devices and model subscriptions or API Keys. Connecting an existing ChatGPT subscription no longer requires purchasing an Amp monthly plan; except for the Enterprise tier, BYOK no longer charges additional token fees or sets Amp-side usage limits. Amp 于 9 月 13 日宣布调整收费方式：用户自带计算设备和模型订阅或 API Key，即可免费使用其编程 Agent。连接已有 ChatGPT 订阅不再要求购买 Amp 月度套餐；除 Enterprise 档外，BYOK 也不再收取额外 token 费用或设置 Amp 侧用量上限。

The newly added Hobby free tier offers all product features and supports public and private code repositories. Agents can be executed on the user's own computer via a runner; if using Amp's remote computer orb to run tasks independently and in parallel, payment is based on usage. Model subscriptions and API calls are still borne by the user, who can also purchase inference services through Amp, which the official states will not be marked up. 新增的 Hobby 免费档开放全部产品功能，支持公开及私有代码仓库。Agent 可以通过 runner 在用户自己的电脑上执行；若使用 Amp 提供的远程电脑 orb，让任务独立、并行运行，则按用量付费。模型订阅和 API 调用仍由用户承担，用户也可通过 Amp 购买推理服务，官方称不加价。

The team workspace has added a free Teams tier, which includes shared tasks, permission management, and unified billing, allowing members to mix free and paid plans. In addition, more BYOK interfaces are being pre-opened to Megawatt and Gigawatt users, including OpenRouter, Amazon Bedrock, and custom endpoints, before being rolled out to all users. 团队工作区新增不额外收费的 Teams 档，包含共享任务、权限管理及统一账单，成员可混用免费与付费套餐。此外，更多 BYOK 接口正向 Megawatt 和 Gigawatt 用户提前开放，包括 OpenRouter、Amazon Bedrock 及自定义 endpoint，之后再推广至所有用户。

item.title: Grok 4.7 延期，马斯克称模型会在难题上过早放弃
item.guid: Grok-4.7-延期，马斯克称模型会在难题上过早放弃
item.description:
Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.7 still needs 'a few more days of polishing.' He had previously announced on September 2 that the model would be released in 10 days, but xAI discovered close to launch that reinforcement learning might have imposed too heavy a penalty on answer length. 马斯克表示，Grok 4.7 还需要「再打磨几天」。他在 9 月 2 日曾预告模型将在 10 天后发布，但 xAI 在临近上线时发现，强化学习可能对回答长度施加了过重惩罚。

Musk said that the model still ends prematurely when faced with difficult tasks it is capable of completing, and it doesn't adequately check its answers. xAI has not yet provided a new specific release date; this delay addresses inference persistence and self-checking quality, rather than new features. 马斯克称，模型面对自己有能力完成的高难度任务时仍会过早结束，也没有充分检查答案。xAI 尚未给出新的具体发布日期；这次延期针对的是推理持续性和自检质量，而非新增功能。

item.title: OpenAI 修复 Astra 提前停止和错回旧消息等问题
item.guid: OpenAI-修复-Astra-提前停止和错回旧消息等问题
item.description:
Tibo Sottiaux, OpenAI Codex Product Lead, announced on September 12 that the team has fixed several quality issues recently reported by Astra users and will complete a reset before midnight that day. OpenAI Codex 产品负责人 Tibo Sottiaux 9 月 12 日表示，团队已修复近期 Astra 用户集中反馈的多项质量问题，并将在当天午夜前完成一次重置。

The reasons he listed include: some skills written for older models were triggering too frequently, potentially preventing the model from checking its own work; an optional context management experiment caused tasks to stop prematurely or the model to reply to earlier messages, affecting an estimated 4,000 to 5,000 users, and this experiment has now been deactivated; some misconfigured inference engines have also been removed, which previously caused a measurable quality degradation in long-tail traffic. 他列出的原因包括：为旧模型编写的部分技能触发过于频繁，或会阻止模型检查自己的工作；一项可选的上下文管理实验会让任务提前停止，或让模型回复较早的消息，团队估计约有 4000 至 5000 名用户受到影响，现已停用该实验；部分配置错误的推理引擎也已被移除，此前它们令长尾流量出现可测量的质量下降。

Sottiaux stated that other minor adjustments will improve task follow-up, identification of the latest messages, and self-checking during execution. This update focuses on the stability and consistency of the existing Astra, not the release of a new model. Sottiaux 称，其他小幅调整将改善任务跟进、最新消息识别和执行过程中的自检。此次更新针对现有 Astra 的稳定性与一致性，并非发布新模型。

item.title: 立讯精密在深圳光博会展示 AR 眼镜光学与感知组件
item.guid: 立讯精密在深圳光博会展示-AR-眼镜光学与感知组件
item.description:
Luxshare Precision and its lens module company, Luxvisions Innovation, showcased waveguide displays, tracking modules, and camera solutions for AR, VR, and XR devices at the China International Optoelectronic Exposition held in Shenzhen. The exhibits also covered automotive cameras, as well as vision modules for AGV and AMR robots. 立讯精密与旗下镜头模组公司立景创新在深圳举行的中国国际光电博览会上，集中展示面向 AR、VR 和 XR 设备的波导显示、追踪模组和摄像头方案。展品还覆盖车载摄像头，以及 AGV 和 AMR 机器人的视觉模组。

Luxshare views its mass production experience with automotive HUDs as a reference path for reducing costs and expanding shipments of AR glasses. The company is currently showcasing a combination of optical, display, and sensing components, and has not released new consumer-facing glasses; this move is more akin to a demonstration of supply chain capabilities. 立讯把车载 HUD 的量产经验视为 AR 眼镜降本与扩大出货的一条参考路径。公司目前展示的是光学、显示和感知零部件组合，并未发布面向消费者的新眼镜；此次动作更接近供应链能力展示。

item.title: 罗永浩评价野人先生冰淇淋「难吃」
item.guid: 罗永浩评价野人先生冰淇淋「难吃」
item.description:
Luo Yonghao stated on Weibo on September 12 that he tried Mr. Savage ice cream at the airport and found the taste to be mediocre, even 'terrible' considering the price, and asked how the brand became popular. He emphasized in his post that this was a normal consumer review and question. 罗永浩 9 月 12 日在微博表示，他在机场尝试了野人先生冰淇淋，觉得口感一般，考虑到价格甚至「可以说难吃」，并询问品牌是如何走红的。他在帖文中强调，这是消费者的正常评价和疑问。

According to a report by Modern Express on September 13, a reporter called Mr. Savage's official customer service, and staff stated that they would record the relevant issues and report them to management; the customer service did not give a clear answer as to whether the brand would respond publicly. 据现代快报 9 月 13 日报道，记者致电野人先生官方客服，工作人员表示，会将相关问题记录并反馈给领导；对品牌是否会公开回应，客服未给出明确答复。

Mr. Savage specializes in Italian artisanal gelato. Its predecessor was 'Yeren Mufang,' founded in 2011, and it changed to its current name in April 2024, with offline stores in several cities across China. 野人先生主打意式手工冰淇淋 Gelato，前身是 2011 年创立的「野人牧坊」，2024 年 4 月更为现名，在国内多个城市设有线下门店。

item.title: 于东来称胖东来今后新员工签四年合同，期满不续签
item.guid: 于东来称胖东来今后新员工签四年合同，期满不续签
item.description:
On September 13, Pang Donglai founder Yu Donglai posted that all new employees hired by the company in the future will join as 'trainees,' with a contract period of four years. Upon expiration, the contract will not be renewed, and they will then enter society. 9 月 13 日，胖东来创始人于东来发文称，公司今后新招员工都将以「学员」性质入职，合同期限为四年，期满不续签，之后走向社会。

Yu Donglai stated that the company will train employees to learn scientific and civilized life philosophies and lifestyles, independent personalities, and relevant skills, hoping to cultivate more outstanding talents for society. 于东来表示，公司会培养员工学习科学文明的生活理念和生活方式、独立人格及相关技术，希望为社会培养更多优秀人才。

He also proposed that particularly professional employees could stay with the company, serving as training masters like teachers. This statement applies to employees hired in the future. 他同时提出，特别专业的员工可以留在企业，像老师一样担任培训师傅。这项表态针对今后招聘的员工。

item.title: 市场监管总局公布 6 起盲盒违法经营案例
item.guid: 市场监管总局公布-6-起盲盒违法经营案例
item.description:
The State Administration for Market Regulation announced 6 cases of illegal blind box operations, involving false prize promotions, disappearing after private collection, selling counterfeit goods, failing to disclose hidden item probabilities, and inducing consumption by minors. 市场监管总局公布 6 起盲盒经营违法案例，涉及虚假中奖宣传、私下收款后失联、销售假冒商品、未公示隐藏款概率和向未成年人诱导消费等行为。

Among them, one company attracted consumers with low-price phone draws and guaranteed prizes, but used small print to hide conditions for monthly phone bill distribution and deductions. After rectification, it shut down its blind box business and refunded consumers. Another operator used short video platforms to attract traffic, asking consumers to add WeChat for transfers, then failed to ship goods and disappeared after receiving payment; the case has been transferred to public security organs. A Shanghai catering enterprise was penalized for failing to disclose the probability of hidden items when selling ceramic blind boxes. 其中，一家公司以低价抽手机和必定中奖吸引消费者，却用小字隐藏话费分月发放和抵扣条件，整改后关停盲盒业务并向消费者退款；另一经营主体通过短视频平台引流，要求消费者添加企业微信转账，收款后不发货并失联，案件已移送公安机关。上海一家餐饮企业则因销售瓷器盲盒时没有公示隐藏款概率受到处罚。

Regulatory authorities used electronic data forensics, cross-platform assistance, and capital chain tracing to identify operating entities in these cases. The cases covered online platforms, private transfers, and offline stores, indicating that blind box regulation is simultaneously checking advertising promises, authenticity of goods, probability disclosure, and protection of minors. 监管部门在这些案件中使用电子数据取证、跨平台协查和资金链追溯确认经营主体。案例覆盖线上平台、私域转账与线下门店，显示盲盒监管正在同时检查广告承诺、商品真伪、概率公示和未成年人保护。

item.title: 《惊爆点》续作剧集获 AMC 预订，计划 2027 年播出
item.guid: 《惊爆点》续作剧集获-AMC-预订，计划-2027-年播出
item.description:
AMC and Canal+ have officially ordered a sequel series to 'Point Break,' planned for filming in Australia and airing in 2027. The story picks up from the 1991 film: a new team linked to the 'Ex-Presidents' robber gang commits crimes again, and an investigator who was once a surfer is sent undercover. AMC 与 Canal+ 已正式预订《惊爆点》续作剧集，计划在澳大利亚拍摄，并于 2027 年播出。故事承接 1991 年电影：一支与「Ex-Presidents」劫匪团伙有关的新队伍再次犯案，一名曾是冲浪选手的调查人员被派去卧底。

The new series is set more than 20 years after the original's ending and will not directly remake the old story of Keanu Reeves and Patrick Swayze. Alcon Entertainment is co-producing with AMC Studios, and the creators and cast are yet to be announced. 新剧把时间推到原作结局 20 多年后，不会直接重拍 Keanu Reeves 和 Patrick Swayze 的旧故事。Alcon Entertainment 与 AMC Studios 共同制作，主创与演员阵容仍有待公布。

item.title: 暴雪宣布与 Netflix 开发《暗黑破坏神》动画剧集
item.guid: 暴雪宣布与-Netflix-开发《暗黑破坏神》动画剧集
item.description:
Johanna Faries, head of Blizzard Entertainment, announced at BlizzCon in Anaheim on September 12 that the company is partnering with Netflix to develop an animated series set in the world of Diablo. The official game account later confirmed this collaboration. 暴雪娱乐负责人 Johanna Faries 在 9 月 12 日于阿纳海姆举行的 BlizzCon 上宣布，公司正在与 Netflix 合作开发一部设定于《暗黑破坏神》世界的动画剧集。游戏官方账号随后确认了这项合作。

Blizzard stated in the project introduction that after decades of building different universes with games, the company is collaborating with creators to bring more stories to screens beyond games. The Diablo animation is part of this initiative, and projects for other game universes are also in preparation. 暴雪在项目介绍中表示，经过数十年用游戏构建不同宇宙，公司正与创作者合作，将更多故事带到游戏之外的屏幕上。《暗黑破坏神》动画属于这项计划的一部分，其他游戏宇宙也有项目在筹备。

The first Diablo game was released in 1996, with three subsequent titles launched in 2000, 2012, and 2023, respectively. The same event also announced that Diablo V is planned for release in spring 2029. 《暗黑破坏神》首作于 1996 年推出，后续三部作品分别在 2000 年、2012 年和 2023 年发售。同场活动还宣布，《暗黑破坏神 V》计划于 2029 年春季推出。
